title: Bike a 13.7 km Loop Atop Xi'an's 650-Year-Old City Wall | China Travel Expert
description:
You can ride a bike a full 13.7 km loop on top of a 650-year-old city wall — and it's the most complete ancient city wall in China.

Xi'an's city wall was finished by Ming-dynasty builders in 1378, raised on older Tang-dynasty foundations. It stands about 12 m tall and 15 m wide, with four great gates and a moat still ringing the outside. Rent a bike at any gate and the full loop takes roughly 80 minutes — a rare chance to circle an entire ancient city from the top of its walls.

🧭 Expert Tip: Rent bikes at the South Gate (Yongningmen) and ride near sunset — cooler air, golden light, and you can return the bike at any of the four gates.
